rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides cryptographic provenance and backtest validation data for financial market growth forecasts. Offers historical datasets spanning 20+ years for SP500 and 7+ years for crypto markets. Delivers forecast vectors at 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day horizons with ALCOA+ compliance for audit trail requirements. Enables verification of model calibration and cross-validation across DeFi, TradFi, and volatility models.
